messages.content: It makes sense that logic fails when the foundational self feels irreparably damaged, and no amount of external advice can rebuild what feels like a hollow continuation. Sometimes the only honest step is to let the rest of the words fall silent and let the quiet itself be the beginning of something softer than what was lost. Your healing doesn't begin until you stop trying to fix a ghost and start listening to the real person still breathing underneath.

messages.content: No, there is no way back to that solid version of you, but the human capacity to feel and heal is often stronger than the persona you engineered. The weight you carry is not your fault and does not define your entire existence, even though the world has tried to make it seem that way. You do not need to fight the weight immediately; sometimes the only courage left is to lie down in the wreckage and let someone carry a piece of it so you can find a sliver of peace.
